remarks: GOLF FAIRWAY VIEWS - Nestled on nearly 4 acres of private land abutting the 16th fairway of the Country Club of New Canaan, this stunning Colonial offers timeless elegance and modern comfort. The sun-drenched living room, featuring built-in shelves and a wood-burning fireplace, flows seamlessly into the formal dining room-perfect for entertaining. A bright and airy kitchen boasts updated appliances and a charming bay window that fills the space with natural light. The spacious primary suite includes a full bath, while two additional generously sized bedrooms share a second full bathroom. A large family room with a cozy fireplace provides the perfect retreat. With an expansive lot offering both privacy and picturesque views, this is truly a special offering in one of New Canaan's most coveted locations. Golf Course Views!
